name: telnyx-developer-kit
description: Telnyx Developer Kit — a curated front door for building with Telnyx: quickstart, product navigator, architecture patterns, security guardrails, error triage, and a Twilio-switch guide, plus the telnyx-builder agent and the hosted Telnyx MCP server for live API access. Covers messaging, email, voice/Call Control, TeXML, WebRTC, Verify, numbers, fax, IoT, video, and Twilio migration.

telnyx_api_key.title: Telnyx API key
telnyx_api_key.description: API key used to authenticate Telnyx MCP requests. Create one at https://portal.telnyx.com/#/app/api-keys.
